source.text: וְאֵ֗לֶּה הַבָּאִ֤ים אֶל־דָּוִיד֙ לְצִ֣יקְלַ֔ג ע֣וֹד עָצ֔וּר מִפְּנֵ֖י שָׁא֣וּל בֶּן־קִ֑ישׁ וְהֵ֨מָּה֙ בַּגִּבּוֹרִ֔ים עֹזְרֵ֖י הַמִּלְחָמָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And these [were] the ones coming to David to Ziklag while still restrained from [the] face of Saul son of Kish; and they [were] among the mighty men, helpers of the war.

en.L: And these [are] the ones who came to David at Ziklag while he was still restrained from the presence of Saul son of Kish; and they [were] among the mighty men, helpers in the war.
en.B: These are the men who came to David at Ziklag while he still could not move about freely because of Saul son of Kish. They were among the warriors who helped him in battle.
en.R: Some men came to join David at Ziklag. This was while David was still kept away from his own land because of Saul son of Kish. These men were among the brave fighters who helped David in battle.

es.L: Y estos [son] los que vinieron a David en Siclag, mientras él estaba aún retenido lejos de la presencia de Saúl hijo de Cis; y ellos [estaban] entre los valientes que ayudaban en la guerra.
es.B: Estos son los hombres que vinieron a David en Siclag cuando todavía no podía moverse con libertad por causa de Saúl hijo de Cis. Estaban entre los guerreros que lo ayudaron en la batalla.
es.R: Algunos hombres vinieron a unirse a David en Siclag. Esto fue cuando David todavía tenía que vivir lejos de su tierra por causa de Saúl hijo de Cis. Estos hombres estaban entre los valientes que ayudaron a David en la batalla.

fr.L: Et voici ceux qui vinrent auprès de David à Tsiqlag, alors qu’il était encore retenu loin de la face de Saül, fils de Kis ; et ils [étaient] parmi les vaillants hommes, des aides dans la guerre.
fr.B: Voici les hommes qui vinrent trouver David à Tsiqlag, alors qu’il ne pouvait pas encore aller librement à cause de Saül, fils de Kis. Ils faisaient partie des guerriers qui l’aidèrent au combat.
fr.R: Des hommes sont venus rejoindre David à Tsiqlag. À ce moment-là, David devait encore rester loin de son pays à cause de Saül, fils de Kis. Ces hommes faisaient partie des combattants courageux qui ont aidé David dans ses batailles.

sw.L: Hawa [ndio] waliokuja kwa Daudi huko Siklagi, alipokuwa bado amezuiliwa mbele ya Sauli mwana wa Kishi; nao [walikuwa] miongoni mwa mashujaa, wasaidizi katika vita.
sw.B: Hawa ndio watu waliokuja kwa Daudi huko Siklagi, wakati ambapo bado hakuweza kutembea kwa uhuru kwa sababu ya Sauli mwana wa Kishi. Walikuwa miongoni mwa mashujaa waliomsaidia vitani.
sw.R: Watu kadhaa walikuja kujiunga na Daudi huko Siklagi. Hii ilikuwa wakati Daudi alipokuwa bado amezuiliwa asikae katika nchi yake kwa sababu ya Sauli mwana wa Kishi. Watu hao walikuwa miongoni mwa wapiganaji hodari waliomsaidia Daudi vitani.

vi.L: Đây [là] những người đã đến với Đa-vít tại Xiếc-lác khi ông còn bị ngăn trở vì Sau-lơ con trai Kích; họ [ở] trong số các dũng sĩ, những người giúp đỡ trong chiến trận.
vi.B: Đây là những người đã đến với Đa-vít tại Xiếc-lác khi ông còn chưa được tự do đi lại vì Sau-lơ con trai Kích. Họ thuộc hàng các chiến binh đã giúp ông trong chiến trận.
vi.R: Có những người đến theo Đa-vít tại Xiếc-lác. Lúc ấy Đa-vít còn phải sống xa quê hương vì Sau-lơ con trai Kích. Những người này thuộc hàng các chiến binh can đảm đã giúp Đa-vít đánh trận.

ko.L: 그리고 이들은 다윗이 아직 기스의 아들 사울 앞에서 갇혀 있을 때에 시글락으로 다윗에게 온 자들이다. 그리고 그들은 용사들 가운데 [있었고], 전쟁을 돕는 자들이었다.
ko.B: 다윗이 기스의 아들 사울 때문에 아직 마음대로 다니지 못하던 때에 시글락으로 그를 찾아온 사람들은 이러하다. 그들은 용사들 가운데 들어 있었고, 싸움에서 다윗을 도왔다.
ko.R: 어떤 사람들이 시글락으로 와서 다윗의 편이 되었다. 그때 다윗은 기스의 아들 사울 때문에 아직 자기 땅에서 살지 못하고 있었다. 이 사람들은 싸움에서 다윗을 도운 용감한 군인들 가운데 있었다.

pt.L: E estes [são] os que vieram a Davi em Ziclague, quando ele ainda estava retido longe da presença de Saul, filho de Quis; e eles [estavam] entre os valentes, ajudantes na guerra.
pt.B: Estes são os homens que vieram a Davi em Ziclague, quando ele ainda não podia andar livremente por causa de Saul, filho de Quis. Eles estavam entre os guerreiros que o ajudaram na batalha.
pt.R: Alguns homens vieram se juntar a Davi em Ziclague. Isso aconteceu quando Davi ainda vivia longe da sua própria terra por causa de Saul, filho de Quis. Esses homens estavam entre os lutadores valentes que ajudaram Davi na batalha.

decisions.choice: Ziklag: the Philistine town where David lived while he fled from Saul
decisions.reason: Achish king of Gath gave David the town of Ziklag when David took refuge among the Philistines to escape Saul (1 Samuel 27:1-7). He lived there a year and four months, until Saul's death (1 Samuel 27:7; 2 Samuel 1:1). Chronicles has just told of Saul's death and of David becoming king (chapters 10-11); here it looks back to show who joined David before that.

decisions.choice: still restrained because of Saul: shut out of his own country and unable to move freely while Saul lived
decisions.reason: The word means held back, shut in or kept away. David was not a prisoner, but Saul's hunt for him kept him out of Israel and in Philistine territory (1 Samuel 27:1, 4).

decisions.choice: among the mighty men, helpers in the war: part of the band of fighters who helped David
decisions.reason: "Mighty men" is the word used for David's famous warriors in 11:10-47. These men belonged to that group of fighters and helped him in his battles. The verb "help" runs through the chapter (verses 18, 19, 20, 22, 23).

decisions.choice: kept away from his own land
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what being held back because of Saul meant for David: he could not live freely in Israel.

decisions.choice: retenido lejos de la presencia de Saúl
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the picture of being held back or shut in; Balanced and Readable say what it meant for David, that he could not move freely in his own land.

decisions.choice: amezuiliwa mbele ya Sauli
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew "restrained from the face of Saul" with the passive "amezuiliwa" (kept back, hindered); Balanced says he could not move freely, and Readable that he was kept out of his own land, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "갇혀 있을 때에"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture of being held back or shut in; Balanced and Readable say what it meant for David, as the English does.

decisions.choice: Ziclague; os valentes (L), os guerreiros (B), os lutadores valentes (R)
decisions.reason: "Ziclague" as 1 Samuel 27:6 in Portuguese. The word for David's warriors keeps the wording of 11:10-47 at Literal and Balanced (m3); Readable says "lutadores valentes", as the English Readable says "brave fighters" here.

source.text: נֹ֣שְׁקֵי קֶ֗שֶׁת מַיְמִינִ֤ים וּמַשְׂמִאלִים֙ בָּֽאֲבָנִ֔ים וּבַחִצִּ֖ים בַּקָּ֑שֶׁת מֵאֲחֵ֥י שָׁא֖וּל מִבִּנְיָמִֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: Equipped of bow, using right hand and using left hand with stones and with arrows with [the] bow; of [the] kinsmen of Saul, from Benjamin.

en.L: armed with [the] bow, using the right hand and the left with stones and with arrows from the bow; of the kinsmen of Saul from Benjamin.
en.B: They were armed with bows, and they could sling stones and shoot arrows with either the right hand or the left. They were kinsmen of Saul from Benjamin.
en.R: They were archers, and they could use either hand to sling stones or shoot arrows. They came from the tribe of Benjamin and were Saul's own relatives.

es.L: armados de arco, usando la mano derecha y la izquierda con piedras y con flechas del arco; de los parientes de Saúl, de Benjamín.
es.B: Iban armados con arcos, y podían lanzar piedras con honda y disparar flechas tanto con la mano derecha como con la izquierda. Eran parientes de Saúl, de Benjamín.
es.R: Eran arqueros, y podían usar cualquiera de las dos manos para lanzar piedras con honda o disparar flechas. Eran de la tribu de Benjamín y parientes del mismo Saúl.

fr.L: armés de l’arc, se servant de la main droite et de la gauche avec des pierres et avec des flèches [tirées] de l’arc ; [ils étaient] des frères de Saül, de Benjamin.
fr.B: Ils étaient armés d’arcs, et ils savaient lancer des pierres à la fronde et tirer des flèches de la main droite comme de la main gauche. C’étaient des frères de tribu de Saül, de Benjamin.
fr.R: C’étaient des archers, et ils pouvaient se servir de leurs deux mains pour lancer des pierres avec une fronde ou pour tirer des flèches. Ils venaient de la tribu de Benjamin et ils étaient de la famille de Saül.

sw.L: wenye pinde, wakitumia mkono wa kuume na wa kushoto kwa mawe na kwa mishale ya upinde; wa ndugu za Sauli, kutoka Benyamini.
sw.B: Walikuwa na pinde, nao waliweza kutupa mawe kwa kombeo na kupiga mishale kwa mkono wa kuume au wa kushoto. Walikuwa ndugu za Sauli kutoka Benyamini.
sw.R: Walikuwa wapiga mishale, nao waliweza kutumia mkono wowote kutupa mawe kwa kombeo au kupiga mishale. Walitoka kabila la Benyamini, nao walikuwa ndugu wa Sauli mwenyewe.

vi.L: được trang bị cung, dùng tay phải và tay trái mà [bắn] đá và bắn tên bằng cung; họ thuộc bà con của Sau-lơ, từ Bên-gia-min.
vi.B: Họ được trang bị cung tên, và có thể dùng cả tay phải lẫn tay trái để ném đá bằng ná hay bắn tên. Họ là bà con của Sau-lơ, thuộc chi tộc Bên-gia-min.
vi.R: Họ là những tay cung thủ, có thể dùng tay nào cũng được để bắn ná hay bắn tên. Họ thuộc chi tộc Bên-gia-min và là bà con của chính Sau-lơ.

ko.L: 활로 무장하고, 오른손으로도 왼손으로도 돌[을 던지고] 활로 화살[을 쏘는] 자들이었다. [그들은] 베냐민 출신으로 사울의 친족이었다.
ko.B: 그들은 활로 무장했고, 오른손으로도 왼손으로도 물매로 돌을 던지고 활을 쏠 수 있었다. 그들은 베냐민 출신으로 사울의 친족이었다.
ko.R: 그들은 활을 쏘는 군인들이었다. 그들은 양손을 다 써서 물매로 돌을 던지거나 활을 쏠 수 있었다. 그들은 베냐민 지파 사람들로, 사울의 친척이었다.

pt.L: armados de arco, usando a mão direita e a esquerda com pedras e com flechas do arco; dos parentes de Saul, de Benjamim.
pt.B: Estavam armados de arcos e podiam atirar pedras com a funda e flechas com o arco, tanto com a mão direita como com a esquerda. Eram parentes de Saul, da tribo de Benjamim.
pt.R: Eles eram arqueiros e podiam usar qualquer uma das mãos para atirar pedras com a funda ou flechas com o arco. Eram da tribo de Benjamim e parentes do próprio Saul.

decisions.choice: using the right hand and the left: able to use either hand
decisions.reason: These fighters could shoot and sling equally well with either hand. Benjamin was known for skilled left-handed fighters (Judges 3:15; 20:16), and the name Benjamin means "son of the right hand".

decisions.choice: with stones: slung stones
decisions.reason: Stones were hurled with a sling, the weapon of Benjamin's left-handed men in Judges 20:16 and of David himself (1 Samuel 17:40, 49).

decisions.choice: kinsmen of Saul from Benjamin: men of Saul's own tribe
decisions.reason: The first men named as joining David came from Saul's own tribe. Chronicles shows that even Saul's kinsmen saw where the kingdom was going (compare verse 30).

decisions.choice: sling stones
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the action, slinging, which the Hebrew leaves to be understood.

decisions.choice: "des frères de tribu de Saül"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "brothers" means kinsmen of the same tribe; French "frères de tribu" keeps the word while saying what kind of brothers.

decisions.choice: atirar pedras com a funda
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the sling, as the English does (m2); "funda" is the word for David's sling in 1 Samuel 17:40 in Portuguese.

source.text: הָרֹ֨אשׁ אֲחִיעֶ֜זֶר וְיוֹאָ֗שׁ בְּנֵי֙ הַשְּׁמָעָ֣ה הַגִּבְעָתִ֔י וִיזִיאֵ֥ל וָפֶ֖לֶט בְּנֵ֣י עַזְמָ֑וֶת וּבְרָכָ֕ה וְיֵה֖וּא הָעֲנְּתֹתִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: The chief Ahiezer, and Joash, sons of the Shemaah the Gibeathite, and Jeziel and Pelet, sons of Azmaveth, and Beracah and Jehu the Anathothite,

en.L: The chief [was] Ahiezer, and Joash, sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; and Jeziel and Pelet, sons of Azmaveth; and Beracah and Jehu the Anathothite,
en.B: Their chief was Ahiezer, and next came Joash, both sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite. There were also Jeziel and Pelet the sons of Azmaveth, and Beracah and Jehu the Anathothite.
en.R: Ahiezer was their leader, and next was Joash. They were sons of Shemaah from Gibeah. Jeziel and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth, were there too, and so were Beracah and Jehu from Anathoth.

es.L: El jefe [era] Ahiezer, y Joás, hijos de Semaa el gabaatita; y Jeziel y Pelet, hijos de Azmavet; y Beraca y Jehú el anatotita,
es.B: Su jefe era Ahiezer, y después venía Joás, ambos hijos de Semaa el gabaatita. También estaban Jeziel y Pelet, hijos de Azmavet, y Beraca y Jehú el anatotita.
es.R: Ahiezer era su líder, y después venía Joás. Eran hijos de Semaa, de Guibeá. También estaban allí Jeziel y Pelet, los hijos de Azmavet, y Beraca y Jehú, de Anatot.

fr.L: Le chef [était] Ahiézer, et Joas, fils de Shemaa, le Guibéatite ; et Yeziel et Pélet, fils d’Azmaveth ; et Beraka, et Jéhu l’Anatotite,
fr.B: Leur chef était Ahiézer, et ensuite venait Joas, tous deux fils de Shemaa le Guibéatite. Il y avait aussi Yeziel et Pélet, les fils d’Azmaveth, ainsi que Beraka et Jéhu l’Anatotite.
fr.R: Ahiézer était leur chef, et ensuite venait Joas. Ils étaient fils de Shemaa, de Guibea. Yeziel et Pélet, les fils d’Azmaveth, étaient là eux aussi, ainsi que Beraka et Jéhu, d’Anatoth.

sw.L: Mkuu [alikuwa] Ahiezeri, na Yoashi, wana wa Shemaa Mgibeathi; na Yezieli na Peleti, wana wa Azmawethi; na Beraka na Yehu Mwanathothi,
sw.B: Mkuu wao alikuwa Ahiezeri, akafuata Yoashi, wote wawili wana wa Shemaa Mgibeathi. Walikuwepo pia Yezieli na Peleti wana wa Azmawethi, na Beraka na Yehu Mwanathothi.
sw.R: Ahiezeri alikuwa kiongozi wao, akafuata Yoashi. Hao walikuwa wana wa Shemaa wa Gibea. Yezieli na Peleti, wana wa Azmawethi, walikuwepo pia, pamoja na Beraka na Yehu wa Anathothi.

vi.L: Người đứng đầu [là] A-hi-ê-xe, và Giô-ách, các con trai Sê-ma người Ghi-bê-a; và Giê-xi-ên và Phê-lết, các con trai Ách-ma-vết; và Bê-ra-ca và Giê-hu người A-na-tốt,
vi.B: Người đứng đầu là A-hi-ê-xe, kế đến là Giô-ách, cả hai là con trai Sê-ma người Ghi-bê-a. Cũng có Giê-xi-ên và Phê-lết, các con trai Ách-ma-vết, và Bê-ra-ca và Giê-hu người A-na-tốt.
vi.R: A-hi-ê-xe là người lãnh đạo, kế đến là Giô-ách. Họ là con trai của Sê-ma ở Ghi-bê-a. Giê-xi-ên và Phê-lết, các con trai Ách-ma-vết, cũng có mặt, cùng với Bê-ra-ca và Giê-hu ở A-na-tốt.

ko.L: 우두머리는 아히에셀, 그리고 요아스, 기브아 사람 스마아의 아들들, 그리고 아스마웻의 아들들 여시엘과 벨렛, 그리고 브라가와 아나돗 사람 예후,
ko.B: 그들의 우두머리는 아히에셀이었고 그다음은 요아스였는데, 둘 다 기브아 사람 스마아의 아들들이었다. 또 아스마웻의 아들들인 여시엘과 벨렛, 그리고 브라가와 아나돗 사람 예후가 있었다.
ko.R: 아히에셀이 그들의 지도자였고, 그다음은 요아스였다. 그들은 기브아 출신 스마아의 아들들이었다. 아스마웻의 아들들인 여시엘과 벨렛도 있었고, 브라가와 아나돗 출신 예후도 있었다.

pt.L: O chefe [era] Aiezer, e Joás, filhos de Semaá, o gibeatita; e Jeziel e Pelete, filhos de Azmavete; e Beraca e Jeú, o anatotita,
pt.B: O chefe deles era Aiezer, e depois vinha Joás, ambos filhos de Semaá, o gibeatita. Havia também Jeziel e Pelete, filhos de Azmavete, e Beraca e Jeú, o anatotita.
pt.R: Aiezer era o líder deles, e depois vinha Joás. Eles eram filhos de Semaá, de Gibeá. Jeziel e Pelete, filhos de Azmavete, também estavam ali, e também Beraca e Jeú, de Anatote.

decisions.choice: the Gibeathite, the Anathothite: from Gibeah and from Anathoth
decisions.reason: These names say where a man came from. Gibeah was Saul's own town (1 Samuel 10:26), and Anathoth was a town of Benjamin given to the priests (Joshua 21:18).

decisions.choice: Jeziel: the name as it is read aloud
alternatives: Jeziel (written with a different vowel letter)
decisions.reason: The written Hebrew text spells this name slightly differently; the traditional reading, followed here, gives Jeziel. The man is the same either way.

decisions.choice: complete sentences for each group
decisions.reason: The Hebrew list of names runs on from verse 3 to verse 8. Literal keeps it as one list; Balanced and Readable give each verse its own sentence. Readable uses the place names ("from Gibeah").

decisions.choice: names transcribed from the Hebrew ("Ahiézer", "Yeziel", "Shemaa")
decisions.reason: The names of these lists not found in the terms notes are written from the Hebrew as in the French of Samuel and 1 Chronicles 11; familiar names keep their usual French form ("Joas", "Jéhu", "Jérémie").

decisions.choice: Mgibeathi, Mwanathothi (L, B); wa Gibea, wa Anathothi (R)
decisions.reason: As in 1 Chronicles 11, a man from a town takes the personal prefix M- / Mw- at Literal and Balanced; Readable names the town with "wa", as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: each verse of the list (3-8) closes as its own sentence at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: The Hebrew list runs from verse 3 to verse 8; Korean, being verb-final, would otherwise hold every name until the verb in verse 8, so Balanced and Readable close each verse, as the English does. Literal keeps the open list.

decisions.choice: the names of 12:3-14 and 12:21 in Brazilian forms
decisions.reason: For the chapter, which has no parallel: names already used in 1 Chronicles 1-9 and Samuel keep their Portuguese forms there (Joás, Pelete, Azmavete, Joanã, Jerimote, Issias, Elcana, Zebadias, Jeroão, Gedor, Ézer, Obadias, Eliabe, Atai, Eliel, Jediael, Micael, Ziletai, Eliú, Jasobeão of 11:11, Joiada, Zadoque); the rest take the usual Brazilian spelling of their sounds (Aiezer, Semaá, Jeziel, Beraca, Ismaías, Jaaziel, Jozabade, Eluzai, Bealias, Semarias, Sefatias, Azarel, Joezer, Joela, Mismana, Elzabade, Macbanai, Amasai, Adna). Gentilics end in "-ita" ("o gibeatita", "o anatotita", "o harufita", "os coraítas" as Exodus 6:24).

source.text: וְיִֽשְׁמַֽעְיָ֧ה הַגִּבְעוֹנִ֛י גִּבּ֥וֹר בַּשְּׁלֹשִׁ֖ים וְעַל־הַשְּׁלֹשִֽׁים׃

records.literal_gloss: and Ishmaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty [man] among the Thirty and over the Thirty,

en.L: and Ishmaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty man among the Thirty and over the Thirty;
en.B: Ishmaiah the Gibeonite was a mighty warrior among the Thirty and a leader over the Thirty.
en.R: Ishmaiah from Gibeon was there too. He was one of David's famous warriors called the Thirty, and he was a leader over them.

es.L: e Ismaías el gabaonita, valiente entre los Treinta y sobre los Treinta;
es.B: Ismaías el gabaonita era un guerrero valiente entre los Treinta y jefe sobre los Treinta.
es.R: También estaba Ismaías, de Gabaón. Era uno de los famosos guerreros de David llamados los Treinta, y era jefe sobre ellos.

fr.L: et Yishmaya le Gabaonite, un vaillant homme parmi les Trente, et au-dessus des Trente ;
fr.B: Yishmaya le Gabaonite était un vaillant guerrier parmi les Trente et un chef au-dessus des Trente.
fr.R: Yishmaya, de Gabaon, était là aussi. C’était l’un des célèbres guerriers de David qu’on appelait les Trente, et il était leur chef.

sw.L: na Ishmaya Mgibeoni, shujaa miongoni mwa wale Thelathini na juu ya wale Thelathini;
sw.B: Ishmaya Mgibeoni alikuwa shujaa miongoni mwa wale Thelathini, na kiongozi juu ya wale Thelathini.
sw.R: Ishmaya wa Gibeoni alikuwepo pia. Alikuwa mmoja wa wapiganaji maarufu wa Daudi walioitwa wale Thelathini, naye alikuwa kiongozi wao.

vi.L: và Dít-ma-gia người Ga-ba-ôn, một dũng sĩ trong nhóm Ba Mươi và đứng đầu nhóm Ba Mươi;
vi.B: Dít-ma-gia người Ga-ba-ôn là một dũng sĩ trong nhóm Ba Mươi và là người đứng đầu nhóm Ba Mươi.
vi.R: Dít-ma-gia ở Ga-ba-ôn cũng có mặt. Ông là một trong những chiến binh nổi tiếng của Đa-vít gọi là nhóm Ba Mươi, và ông lãnh đạo nhóm ấy.

ko.L: 그리고 기브온 사람 이스마야, 삼십 인 가운데 용사요 삼십 인 위에 [있는 자],
ko.B: 기브온 사람 이스마야는 삼십 인 가운데 한 용사였고 삼십 인을 이끄는 사람이었다.
ko.R: 기브온 출신 이스마야도 있었다. 그는 삼십 용사라고 불리는 다윗의 이름난 용사들 가운데 하나였고, 그들의 지도자였다.

pt.L: e Ismaías, o gibeonita, valente entre os Trinta e sobre os Trinta;
pt.B: Ismaías, o gibeonita, era um guerreiro entre os Trinta e líder dos Trinta.
pt.R: Ismaías, de Gibeom, também estava ali. Ele era um dos guerreiros famosos de Davi chamados os Trinta, e era líder deles.

decisions.choice: verse numbers: the Hebrew text divides this verse in two
decisions.reason: This translation numbers verses as the Hebrew text does. Here the Hebrew ends verse 4 after "over the Thirty" and makes the next names (Jeremiah to Jozabad the Gederathite) verse 5. Many Bibles join the two into one verse 4, so from verse 5 to the end of the chapter their numbers are one lower than here (Hebrew 12:5-41 is 12:4-40 in those Bibles). The words are the same; only the numbers differ.

decisions.choice: the Thirty: David's company of famous warriors
decisions.reason: The Thirty were David's best-known fighting men, listed in 11:11-47 and 2 Samuel 23:8-39. Ishmaiah is not named in those lists; here he is both one of them and a leader over them.

decisions.choice: the Gibeonite: from Gibeon
decisions.reason: Gibeon was a town in the land of Benjamin (Joshua 18:25), so Ishmaiah belongs with the Benjaminites of verse 2.

decisions.choice: "삼십 인" (L, B), "삼십 용사" (R)
decisions.reason: The fixed Korean name for David's company called the Thirty, as in chapter 11.

decisions.choice: os Trinta
decisions.reason: The group of 11:11-47, with a capital at every level (m2).

es.R: Jeremías, Jahaziel, Johanán y Jozabad, de Gedera, también estaban allí.

sw.R: Yeremia, Yahazieli, Yohana na Yozabadi wa Gedera walikuwepo pia.

vi.B: Cùng với họ có Giê-rê-mi, Gia-ha-xi-ên, Giô-ha-nan và Giô-xa-bát người Ghê-đê-ra.
vi.R: Giê-rê-mi, Gia-ha-xi-ên, Giô-ha-nan và Giô-xa-bát ở Ghê-đê-ra cũng có mặt.

ko.B: 그들과 함께 예레미야, 야하시엘, 요하난, 그데라 사람 요사밧이 있었다.
ko.R: 예레미야, 야하시엘, 요하난, 그데라 출신 요사밧도 있었다.

pt.L: e Jeremias, e Jaaziel, e Joanã, e Jozabade, o gederatita,
pt.B: Com eles estavam Jeremias, Jaaziel, Joanã e Jozabade, o gederatita.
pt.R: Jeremias, Jaaziel, Joanã e Jozabade, de Gedera, também estavam ali.

decisions.choice: the Gederathite: from Gederah
decisions.reason: The name says where Jozabad came from, probably a town called Gederah. The place is not certainly known; a Gederah in the lowland of Judah is named in Joshua 15:36.

decisions.choice: With them were (B); were also there (R)
decisions.reason: As in verse 3, Balanced and Readable give each group of names its own sentence.

decisions.choice: de Gedera (R)
decisions.reason: Readable names the town, in the form of Joshua 15:36 and 1 Chronicles 4:23 in Portuguese (m1).

records.literal_gloss: Eluzai and Jerimoth and Bealiah and Shemariah and Shephatiah the Haruphite,

vi.B: Cũng có Ê-lu-xai, Giê-ri-mốt, Bê-a-lia, Sê-ma-ria và Sê-pha-tia người Ha-rốp.
vi.R: Ê-lu-xai, Giê-ri-mốt, Bê-a-lia, Sê-ma-ria và Sê-pha-tia ở Ha-rốp cũng vậy.

ko.L: 엘루새와 여리못과 브아랴와 스마랴와 하룹 사람 스바댜,
ko.B: 또 엘루새, 여리못, 브아랴, 스마랴, 하룹 사람 스바댜가 그들과 함께 있었다.
ko.R: 엘루새, 여리못, 브아랴, 스마랴, 하룹 출신 스바댜도 있었다.

pt.L: Eluzai, e Jerimote, e Bealias, e Semarias, e Sefatias, o harufita,
pt.B: Também estavam com eles Eluzai, Jerimote, Bealias, Semarias e Sefatias, o harufita.
pt.R: Também estavam ali Eluzai, Jerimote, Bealias, Semarias e Sefatias, de Harufe.

decisions.choice: the Haruphite: the form as it is read aloud
decisions.reason: The written Hebrew text has a slightly different spelling (Hariphite, compare the family of Hariph in Nehemiah 7:24); the traditional reading, followed here, gives Haruphite. The place itself is not known.

en.R: Elkanah, Isshiah, Azarel, Joezer and Jashobeam, from the family of Korah, came too.

ko.R: 고라 집안 사람들인 엘가나, 잇시야, 아사렐, 요에셀, 야소브암도 왔다.

pt.L: Elcana, e Issias, e Azarel, e Joezer, e Jasobeão, os coraítas,
pt.B: Elcana, Issias, Azarel, Joezer e Jasobeão, que eram coraítas, também estavam ali.
pt.R: Elcana, Issias, Azarel, Joezer e Jasobeão, da família de Corá, também vieram.

decisions.choice: the Korahites: men of a family called after Korah
decisions.reason: Korahites are usually the Levite family descended from Korah (Exodus 6:24; 1 Chronicles 9:19). Since this list is of Benjaminites (verse 2), these may instead be a Benjaminite family named after another Korah. The text does not say which.

vi.B: Giô-ê-la và Xê-ba-đia, các con trai Giê-rô-ham ở Ghê-đô, cũng vậy.

ko.L: 그리고 그돌 출신 여로함의 아들들 요엘라와 스바댜.

pt.B: Também vieram Joela e Zebadias, filhos de Jeroão, de Gedor.
pt.R: E Joela e Zebadias, filhos de Jeroão, de Gedor, também se juntaram a Davi.

decisions.choice: Gedor: a town, not certainly identified
decisions.reason: A Gedor in the hill country of Judah is named in Joshua 15:58, and a Benjaminite family named Gedor appears in 8:31 and 9:37. Which is meant here is not known.

source.text: וּמִן־הַגָּדִ֡י נִבְדְּל֣וּ אֶל־דָּוִיד֩ לַמְצַ֨ד מִדְבָּ֜רָה גִּבֹּרֵ֣י הַחַ֗יִל אַנְשֵׁ֤י צָבָא֙ לַמִּלְחָמָ֔ה עֹרְכֵ֥י צִנָּ֖ה וָרֹ֑מַח וּפְנֵ֤י אַרְיֵה֙ פְּנֵיהֶ֔ם וְכִצְבָאיִ֥ם עַל־הֶהָרִ֖ים לְמַהֵֽר׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And from the Gadites separated themselves to David to [the] stronghold toward [the] wilderness, mighty men of the valor, men of [the] army for the war, arranging shield and spear; and faces of a lion [were] their faces, and like gazelles on the mountains to hasten.

en.L: And from the Gadites [some] separated themselves to David at the stronghold in the wilderness, mighty men of valor, men of the army for war, handling shield and spear; and their faces [were] the faces of a lion, and [they were] like gazelles on the mountains for swiftness.
en.B: Some Gadites broke away and went over to David at the stronghold in the wilderness. They were mighty warriors, trained soldiers ready for battle, skilled with shield and spear. Their faces were the faces of lions, and on the mountains they ran as swiftly as gazelles.
en.R: Some men from the tribe of Gad left their people and joined David at his fortress in the desert. They were brave warriors, trained for war and skilled with shields and spears. They looked as fierce as lions, and they could run as fast as gazelles on the mountains.

es.L: Y de los gaditas [algunos] se pasaron a David, a la fortaleza del desierto, hombres valientes y esforzados, hombres de guerra para la batalla, que manejaban escudo y lanza; y sus rostros [eran] rostros de león, y [eran] como gacelas sobre los montes en ligereza.
es.B: Algunos gaditas se separaron de su tribu y se pasaron a David en la fortaleza del desierto. Eran guerreros valientes, soldados entrenados para la batalla, diestros con el escudo y la lanza. Sus rostros eran rostros de león, y en los montes corrían tan ligeros como gacelas.
es.R: Algunos hombres de la tribu de Gad dejaron a su gente y se unieron a David en su fortaleza del desierto. Eran guerreros valientes, entrenados para la guerra y hábiles con el escudo y la lanza. Parecían tan feroces como leones, y podían correr tan rápido como las gacelas en los montes.

fr.L: Et parmi les Gadites, [certains] se séparèrent pour [aller] vers David à la forteresse du désert, vaillants hommes, hommes d’armée pour la guerre, maniant le bouclier et la lance ; et leurs faces [étaient] des faces de lion, et [ils étaient] comme des gazelles sur les montagnes pour la rapidité.
fr.B: Des Gadites se séparèrent de leur tribu et passèrent du côté de David, à la forteresse du désert. C’étaient de vaillants guerriers, des soldats entraînés pour le combat, habiles au bouclier et à la lance. Ils avaient des faces de lion, et sur les montagnes ils couraient aussi vite que des gazelles.
fr.R: Des hommes de la tribu de Gad ont quitté leur peuple et ils ont rejoint David dans sa forteresse au désert. C’étaient des guerriers courageux, entraînés pour la guerre et habiles avec le bouclier et la lance. Ils avaient l’air aussi féroces que des lions, et ils pouvaient courir aussi vite que des gazelles dans les montagnes.

sw.L: Na kutoka kwa Wagadi [wengine] walijitenga wakaenda kwa Daudi kwenye ngome iliyo nyikani, mashujaa hodari, watu wa jeshi kwa ajili ya vita, wakishika ngao na mkuki; na nyuso zao [zilikuwa] nyuso za simba, na [walikuwa] kama paa juu ya milima kwa wepesi.
sw.B: Baadhi ya Wagadi walijitenga wakaenda kwa Daudi kwenye ngome iliyo nyikani. Walikuwa mashujaa hodari, askari waliofunzwa tayari kwa vita, stadi wa kutumia ngao na mkuki. Nyuso zao zilikuwa kama nyuso za simba, nao walikimbia milimani kwa wepesi kama paa.
sw.R: Watu kadhaa wa kabila la Gadi waliwaacha watu wao wakajiunga na Daudi kwenye ngome yake nyikani. Walikuwa wapiganaji jasiri, waliofunzwa vita na stadi wa kutumia ngao na mikuki. Walionekana wakali kama simba, nao waliweza kukimbia milimani kwa kasi kama paa.

vi.L: Từ người Ga-đít, [có những người] tách ra theo Đa-vít tại đồn trong hoang mạc, là những dũng sĩ can trường, những người lính sẵn sàng chiến đấu, thạo dùng khiên và giáo; mặt họ [là] mặt sư tử, và [họ] nhanh như linh dương trên núi.
vi.B: Có những người Ga-đít tách ra theo Đa-vít tại đồn trong hoang mạc. Họ là những dũng sĩ, những người lính thiện chiến sẵn sàng ra trận, thạo dùng khiên và giáo. Mặt họ như mặt sư tử, và họ chạy nhanh như linh dương trên núi.
vi.R: Có những người thuộc chi tộc Gát bỏ dân mình mà theo Đa-vít tại pháo đài của ông trong hoang mạc. Họ là những chiến binh can đảm, được luyện tập để đánh trận và thạo dùng khiên và giáo. Trông họ dữ tợn như sư tử, và họ chạy nhanh như linh dương trên núi.

ko.L: 그리고 갓 사람들 가운데서 [몇 사람이] 광야의 요새로 다윗에게 갈라져 나왔는데, 그들은 용맹한 용사들이요 전쟁을 위한 군대의 사람들이요 방패와 창을 다루는 자들이었다. 그들의 얼굴은 사자의 얼굴이었고, 산 위의 영양들처럼 빨랐다.
ko.B: 갓 사람들 가운데 몇 사람이 갈라져 나와 광야의 요새에 있는 다윗에게로 갔다. 그들은 용맹한 용사들이었고, 싸움을 위해 훈련받은 군인들로서 방패와 창을 잘 다루었다. 그들의 얼굴은 사자의 얼굴 같았고, 산 위에서 영양처럼 빨리 달렸다.
ko.R: 갓 지파 사람들 가운데 몇 사람이 자기 지파를 떠나 광야에 있는 다윗의 요새로 와서 그의 편이 되었다. 그들은 용감한 군인들이었고, 싸우는 훈련을 받아 방패와 창을 잘 다루었다. 그들은 사자처럼 사나워 보였고, 산 위의 영양처럼 빨리 달릴 수 있었다.

pt.L: E dos gaditas [alguns] se separaram [e foram] para Davi, para a fortaleza no deserto, valentes guerreiros, homens do exército para a guerra, que manejavam escudo e lança; e os seus rostos [eram] rostos de leão, e [eram] como gazelas sobre os montes em rapidez.
pt.B: Alguns gaditas se separaram dos seus e passaram para o lado de Davi na fortaleza no deserto. Eram guerreiros valentes, soldados treinados e prontos para a batalha, hábeis com o escudo e a lança. Tinham rosto de leão e corriam pelos montes, rápidos como gazelas.
pt.R: Alguns homens da tribo de Gade deixaram o seu povo e se juntaram a Davi na sua fortaleza no deserto. Eram guerreiros corajosos, treinados para a guerra e hábeis com escudos e lanças. Tinham a aparência feroz de leões e corriam pelos montes tão rápido quanto gazelas.

decisions.choice: the stronghold in the wilderness: David's refuge while Saul hunted him
decisions.reason: Before David went to Ziklag he hid in strongholds in the wilderness of Judah (1 Samuel 22:4-5; 23:14). The Gadites came to him there, so the chapter is not in time order: it gathers all who joined David before he became king.

decisions.choice: separated themselves: broke with their own tribe to join David
decisions.reason: The verb means to separate or set oneself apart. Gad lived east of the Jordan, and these men left Saul's side to go over to David.

decisions.choice: faces of a lion ... like gazelles on the mountains: fierce and fast
decisions.reason: Two pictures praise the Gadites: they looked as fierce as lions, and they were as quick on their feet as gazelles in the hills. David's lament praises Saul and Jonathan with the same kinds of picture (2 Samuel 1:23), and Asahel is called as swift as a gazelle (2 Samuel 2:18).

decisions.choice: mighty men of valor: strong, brave warriors
decisions.reason: The phrase names seasoned fighting men (Joshua 1:14; 10:7; 2 Kings 24:14). It recurs in verses 22, 26, 29 and 31 and is given the same wording each time.

decisions.choice: mighty warriors (B); brave warriors (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "mighty men of valor". Balanced says "mighty warriors", as in 2 Kings 5:1 and 24:14, and Readable "brave warriors"; the same words are used for this phrase throughout the chapter.

decisions.choice: hombres valientes y esforzados
decisions.reason: Literal renders "mighty men of valor" with a Spanish pair rather than "valientes de valor", which repeats itself; Balanced and Readable say "guerreros valientes".

decisions.choice: "vaillants guerriers" (B); "guerriers courageux" (R)
decisions.reason: "Mighty men of valor" has one wording per level through the chapter (verses 9, 22, 26, 29, 31), as the meaning decision asks.

decisions.choice: mashujaa hodari (L, B); wapiganaji jasiri (R)
decisions.reason: "Mighty men of valor" is "mashujaa hodari", the same words through these lists; Readable says "brave fighters".

decisions.reason: As the Vietnamese 2 Samuel, a Gadite is "người Ga-đít", kept apart from Gath ("Gát"); Readable names the tribe "chi tộc Gát".

decisions.choice: "용맹한 용사들" (L, B); "용감한 군인들" (R)
decisions.reason: One wording for "mighty men of valor" through the chapter (verses 9, 22, 26, 29, 31), as the English keeps one.

decisions.choice: valentes guerreiros (L); guerreiros valentes (B); guerreiros corajosos (R)
decisions.reason: As set for the whole book in 1 Chronicles 5:24 in Portuguese, one wording per level for "mighty men of valor" (m4), here and in verses 22, 26, 29 and 31.

decisions.choice: the least for a hundred, the greatest for a thousand: even the weakest was equal to a hundred men
alternatives: the least was over a hundred, and the greatest over a thousand
decisions.reason: The words can be read as praise of their strength, like "five of you will chase a hundred" (Leviticus 26:8) and "how could one chase a thousand" (Deuteronomy 32:30). They can also be read as their rank: the least of them commanded a hundred men and the greatest a thousand. The praise fits the lions and gazelles of verse 9; the rank fits "heads of the army" just before.

decisions.choice: heads of the army: officers
decisions.reason: "Heads" here are leaders in the army. Verse 19 says David made some of these newcomers leaders of his band.

decisions.choice: the weakest ... the strongest
decisions.reason: "The least" and "the greatest" here compare the men's strength, which Readable says in plain words.
